instagram.caption:
What you are actually required to keep.
The File Storage in the Home Office. Keep the documents you are genuinely required to hold, and put your hand on any one of them without opening a second drawer.

What done looks like:
1. Hanging folders labelled by the question you would ask when looking
2. Tabs all in the same position so your eye runs one straight line
3. A closed fireproof box holding the permanent originals
4. A full shred bag by the door ready to go

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success file storage.
